title: HighHttp5xxErrorRate
queries:
100 * (sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="trova-prod", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[5m])) or vector(0))
  / sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="trova-prod", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m]))
and on()
  sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="trova-prod", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) >= 20

title: HighHttpLatencyP95
queries:
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="trova-prod", uri!~"/actuator.*|/api/shares"}[5m])))
and on()
  sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="trova-prod", uri!~"/actuator.*|/api/shares"}[5m])) >= 20
